PanoApiLevel.description: The API level this Pano implements.

Error.description: The body of every non-2xx answer.

fields.description: Field name to code, for a rejected form.

Page.description: Where a list stands: page numbers start at 1, `pageSize` is at most 100.

bearerAuth.description: A site session token, sent by a server-side front-end that holds a front-end key. Not valid on the panel API.

sessionCookie.description: The session cookie set by login. A mutation also repeats the `pano_csrf_token` cookie in the `X-CSRF-Token` header. Behind a plain-http origin the cookie names end in `_http`.
sessionCookie.name: pano_auth_token

info.description: The public API of the plugin pano-plugin-market, served below /api/v1/plugins/pano-plugin-market.
info.title: Pano plugin API: pano-plugin-market

get.summary: A category image file.

503.description: Service unavailable: MAINTENANCE_MODE_ENABLED, STORE_BUSY, STORE_DISABLED, STORE_UNAVAILABLE

post.summary: Creates an order from a cart and starts its payment. Needs an Idempotency-Key header; the order token is returned only here.

get.summary: What the checkout page needs before it prices a cart: guest and gift switches, billing mode, address fields, legal text, currencies and credit top-up limits.

post.summary: Prices a cart. It never fails for a business reason: problems come back as messages with canCheckout false.

get.summary: The saved shipping addresses of the buyer.

post.summary: Saves a shipping address and answers its id.

delete.summary: Empties the cart and answers it with its quote.

get.summary: The cart of the signed-in buyer with its real quote.

put.summary: Replaces the whole cart and answers it with its quote.

post.summary: Adds a line to the cart and answers it with its quote.

delete.summary: Removes a cart line and answers the cart with its quote.

put.summary: Changes a cart line and answers the cart with its quote.

post.summary: Merges a guest cart into the stored cart and answers it with its quote.

get.summary: The creator codes of the buyer with their earnings; 404 when the buyer has none.
The credit balance and the ledger of the buyer.
What the buyer owns, gifts included.

post.summary: Redeems a gift code and answers the order it creates.

get.summary: The orders of the buyer and the gifts the buyer received, newest first.
The subscriptions of the buyer.
The page a billing portal address resolves to.

post.summary: Cancels a subscription, or answers the address where the provider cancels it.
The address of the provider's billing portal for a subscription.

get.summary: What a navbar badge and the profile navigation need: credit balance, cart size and subscription counts.
One order, cut down to what the caller may see: the owner (session or order token), the gift recipient, or anyone else.

post.summary: The buyer says a bank transfer was sent; the store checks it by hand.

get.summary: The PDF invoice of a paid order.

post.summary: Starts a payment for a pending order with the chosen method.
Continues the open payment attempt of an order.

get.summary: The small status answer a page polls while a payment settles.
The logo of a payment provider.
The hosted page of a payment attempt, for providers that show instructions.
A product or variant image file.
One product page: description, variants, custom fields, bundle items and whether the caller can buy it.
The store front: settings, the category tree, the first page of products, featured and bestselling products and the comparisons.
A filtered and sorted page of products.
The store modules for a sidebar or the home page: recent buyers, top supporters, community goals and statistics, each only when its module is on.
